summary: Quiet week: 12 messages, and only 3 of them from the client. All three were about Facebook, and they sounded fed up: 'So we have no time line' / 'Is this normal to be slow like this ??' / '8 weeks in' (2026-09-28). The page has been flagged for 370 days, 56 of them with Vivek on it. She did not reply to his excuse. Last week she had stopped mentioning Facebook. This week she raised it again, which is better than silence, but she is now openly asking whether this speed is normal. DMCA IS BACK: Melissa posted the weekly leak-removal update on 2026-09-25. Mayson offered 11am EST on 2026-09-23, then sent no link, no confirmation and no rebooking. Ten days later nobody has mentioned it. BILLING: Stephski sent the Sep 15-30 invoice on 2026-10-01, due about 2026-10-08. As before, the total is only in the PDF and not in the message, and the 'avoid any pausing in work' line is still there. The heads-up the day before (withdraw her OnlyFans balance), which got last cycle paid on time, was not repeated. Nobody has confirmed what she paid on 2026-09-22 or which account it went to. She has not answered Melissa's 2026-09-28 intake-form link for the new private platform. CHURN WATCH: two signs are present. (a) She is quiet and short: 3 messages all week, all frustration, no greetings. (b) Last week she paid on time without asking for anything. No requests for data, exports or logins, and no mention of other agencies or doing it herself. 'Is this normal' is the first time she has asked us to compare ourselves against a norm. Watch it.

BAD: the client is frustrated and openly comparing us to a norm ('Is this normal to be slow like this ??', '8 weeks in'). Vivek only answers when tagged, and his answer blames Meta with no timeline.
